dependencies.name: apache-airflow
dependencies.note: Lessons were framed for 3.3.2 on 13 October 2026.

airflow.vendor_note: Lessons were framed on 13 October 2026 for Apache Airflow 3.3.2.

clickhouse.vendor_note: Lessons were framed on 13 October 2026 for MergeTree, the JSON type since 25.3, and ClickHouse Cloud SharedMergeTree.

data-science.vendor_note: The course hub is data_science_course/index.html. data-science-basics.html remains a separate overview page.

dbt.vendor_note: Lessons were framed on 13 October 2026 for the dbt Developer Hub, Fusion v2.0.8, and dbt-core as the Apache-licensed runtime.

dms.vendor_note: Premigration assessment, DMS Schema Conversion, and the desktop AWS SCT are described as three different reports.

kubernetes.vendor_note: Lessons do not pin one patch release. The Gateway API 1.5 notes cited Kubernetes 1.30 or later for that release.

llm.vendor_note: Lessons distinguish the 2019 GPT-2 decoder from ChatGPT.

metabase.vendor_note: Lessons keep Cloud, self-host, embedding, models, and permissions. They do not publish an application-database password.

mssql.vendor_note: Lessons were framed on 13 October 2026 for SQL Server 2017, 2019, 2022, and 2025. SQL Server 2016 extended support had ended on 15 July 2026.

postgres.vendor_note: Lessons were framed on 13 October 2026 for PostgreSQL 18.6 as the current major, with 17, 16, and 15 still supported. PostgreSQL 14 support was dated through 12 November 2026.

python.vendor_note: Sessions 13 and 14 teach matplotlib and seaborn.

redshift.vendor_note: Lessons keep the October 2026 caveats on zero-ETL, data sharing, RA3, Serverless, and Spectrum. They do not tell a new warehouse to start on DC2.

snowflake.vendor_note: Thirteen lessons are on the hub. Two are free. No separate vendor patch version is stamped.

terraform.vendor_note: S3 locking is described as version-dependent. OpenTofu is a separate project.
